description: A release must be a week old before it reaches a pull request: most compromised packages are pulled within days. Actions and base images stay pinned by digest, and Renovate keeps the digests fresh.

packageRules.description: Conventional Commit scope required by commitlint.

A base image is what the app ships, and only fix and feat cut a release: as a chore its digest would be merged and reach nobody. Three days, because Docker Hub ages a digest by the tag's last push, and an official image is pushed again often enough that a week could hold it back for good.
Our own images: the homelab follows its tag on purpose; promote.yml moves `stable`.
CLAUDE.md: no TypeScript 7 while vue-tsc lags behind.
